decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation costs little to keep as an accessory within the laser line, but its website presence is only a mention and the newer LC400 cabin overlaps with it, so its option value is modest yet not clearly exhausted.

The thermal inkjet printer has kept its own page in both years, is part of the firm's core high-resolution printing portfolio and earns recurring consumables revenue, so dropping it would forgo value at little saving.
The piezo inkjet printer has a stable dedicated presence and matches the firm's strategy of fitting a technology to each surface, so the option stays open at low holding cost.
As the flagship featured on the home page and central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, the industrial laser systems warrant further commitment rather than abandonment.
The compact laser cabin was only launched in 2024 and its prospects are still uncertain, while holding it costs little and it fits the laser focus, so the option should remain open.
The lubricant printing system won a trade-fair award, an early positive signal in a niche sheet-metal application that justifies keeping it while its market value becomes clearer.
